parameters.name: DBClusterDescription
parameters.description:
The name of the cluster. The name must meet the following requirements:

*   The name cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
*   The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-db-cluster-description --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --db-cluster-description ClusterDescriptionTest --region cn-hangzhou
